Subject: Initial request: DPIA support + Art.28/30 docs

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this — Acme is starting a privacy review for our new integration with Redwood. Our privacy team has a few specific asks we need to clear up before procurement can sign off:

- A short DPIA summary showing the data flows relevant to our use case (PII categories, retention, processors/subprocessors).
- A copy of the current DPA and any variance guidance for EU data transfers (SCCs or adequacy measures).
- Documentation that satisfies GDPR Art. 28 obligations (processor obligations) and Art. 30 records of processing activities for services provided to us.
- A complete, up-to-date list of subprocessors and whether any subprocessors process data outside the EEA.
- Confirmation of audit rights (what evidence you will provide during a customer audit and timelines).

Can you confirm what you can share directly, and whether you can support a short call with our privacy counsel (DataLaw) next week? We may also need SOC2 attestation and any third-party security assessments.

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Privacy Program Manager
Acme Corp

Monica — thanks for flagging. Action plan below.

1) DPA & transfer guidance — attached: Redwood_DPA_2025.pdf. We have standard SCCs available; for Acme's EU flows we recommend relying on SCCs and the transfer impact assessment we maintain. We will include a short note on what additional safeguards (if any) we apply.

2) Art.28 / Art.30 documentation — attached: GDPR_Art28-30_Matrix.xlsx. That spreadsheet maps processor obligations in the DPA to our operational controls and includes a high-level ROPA excerpt we can share.

3) Subprocessors — attached: Subprocessor_List_2025.csv. Rishi, please confirm locations for any hosts in APAC.

4) DPIA support — I've drafted a DPIA summary tailored to Acme's typical integration patterns (DPIA_Summary_Acme.docx). It includes data flow notes and recommended mitigations. This is marked as customer-facing; feel free to review.

5) Audit rights / evidence — Stephanie to add cover note. In brief: we provide our most recent SOC2 Type II report (redacted), system architecture diagrams where helpful, and a documented process for customer audits. For on-site audits we require 30 days' notice; for remote evidence requests we aim to respond within 10 business days for standard artifacts. Complex deep-dive requests will be scoped separately.

DocuSign note: I will prepare the editable DPA (if they need signature) and send via DocuSign — see link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-Redwood-DPA.

Let me know if you'd like any language softened before we send to the customer.
